components.css: .ds-key { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; width: 320px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: #1c1c1c; font: 700 18px/1 Barlow, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 12px 22px -14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-key-face { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: -1; } .ds-key:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 12px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #f4f5f7; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-ears { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; text-align: center; font-family: Barlow, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ear { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-ear-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-2, #b0b0b0); } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 26px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-chip-l { background: var(--l, #2b52d1); color: var(--l-ink, #dfe7ff); } .ds-chip-r { background: var(--r, #c8452e); color: #fff; }

components.name: Stamp Plates

components.html: FixingOffSnap first
components.css: .ds-stamps { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; } .ds-stamp { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 9px 6px; font: 700 11.5px/1 Barlow, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-plate { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: -1; overflow: visible; } .ds-on { color: #1c1c1c; } .ds-on rect { fill: var(--text, #efefef); } .ds-off { color: var(--text-2, #b0b0b0); } .ds-off rect { fill: var(--ground-2, #2a2a2a); } .ds-cue { color: var(--text, #efefef); } .ds-cue rect { fill: var(--ground-3, #333333); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Native radios styled as a graphite track; checked option inverts to chalk (Before / After).
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding: 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--ground-3, #333333); font-family: Barlow, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg label { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-seg input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg span { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-2, #b0b0b0); transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-seg input:hover + span { color: var(--text, #efefef); } .ds-seg input:checked + span { background: var(--text, #efefef); color: var(--ground, #222222); box-shadow: 0 2px 5px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); } .ds-seg input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2.5px solid var(--focus, #f4f5f7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Native checkbox as a pill; on fills chalk with a ground knob.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-flex; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch span { position: relative; width: 50px; height: 30px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--ground-3, #333333); border: 1.5px solid var(--line-2, #525252); transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms; } .ds-switch span::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 21px; height: 21px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-2, #b0b0b0); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms; } .ds-switch input:checked + span { background: var(--text, #efefef); border-color: var(--text, #efefef); } .ds-switch input:checked + span::after { transform: translateX(20px); background: var(--ground, #222222); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2.5px solid var(--focus, #f4f5f7); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The L and R that every listener checks before pressing play are the interface. Two earcup pads, cobalt on the left and vermilion on the right, sit on a neutral graphite ground like a pair of soft-touch headphones laid on a desk. Their letters are debossed at monumental scale and lit by a single light source through real height-map lighting, so the relief comes from light falling on a shape and never from painted bevels. Everything else on the page (the file, the player, the fix list, the reading sections) is quiet graphite and one family of type, so the pads keep the colour and the attention.

The system is dark only, chosen from the use scene: artists open it late at night next to recording rooms and editing tools. The ground carries a fixed 7% fractal-noise grain so it reads as a material, not a void. Depth is tactile: molded keys you press, plates that stand up when a setting is engaged and sink in when it is off. Motion is rare and physical. The pads are the ears and never move; when the recording is re-routed, the small "recorded left / recorded right" tags under them trade places.

It refuses the dark DAW with a neon waveform and the pastel moon-and-clouds "sleepy ASMR" page.
keyCharacteristics: Two molded pads (cobalt L, vermilion R) are the hero and, once a file loads, a sticky meter band.
Lit SVG relief (feDiffuseLighting and feSpecularLighting on height maps) for every molded surface.
Neutral graphite ground with a fixed 7% grain; dark only.
One family, self-hosted Barlow 400 to 800, on one grid.
Channel colour discipline: blue means left, red means right, purple means sound both share.
Tags trade places; pads never move.

rules.name: The Ears Rule
rules.body: Blue is left and red is right, everywhere: pads, tags, waveform, inline words. A channel colour never decorates anything that is not that channel.

rules.name: The Shared Purple Rule
rules.body: Purple appears only where both channels carry the same sound (waveform core and pad meters). It is never an accent, a link, or a state colour.

rules.name: The Quiet Ground Rule
rules.body: Outside the pads and route tags, the interface is graphite and chalk. Engaged and checked states use chalk inversion, not a channel colour.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Barlow sets everything: letters, captions, buttons, canvas labels. No second face.

rules.name: The Monument Rule
rules.body: Only the pad letters are monumental. Page headings stay at or below 40px.

rules.name: The Real Light Rule
rules.body: Relief comes from lighting a height map. No CSS bevels, inset highlight stacks, or text-shadow embossing.

rules.name: The Raised-Engaged Rule
rules.body: A plate stands up when its setting is on or applied and sinks in when it is off or not needed.

dos: **Do** render every molded surface (pads, socket, keys, plates) through the shared lighting in relief.js with the single light at azimuth 235, elevation 52.
**Do** keep blue for left, red for right and purple only for shared sound, in every view that shows channels.
**Do** show engaged settings as raised plates and off settings as pressed plates.
**Do** move the route tags, never the pads, to show re-routing.
**Do** use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for state motion (140 to 180ms on controls, 640ms for the swap, 900ms for meter sweeps) and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
**Do** keep the 7% grain fixed behind everything, including the sticky band.
donts: **Don't** add a light theme; the system is dark only by use scene.
**Don't** fake relief with CSS bevels, inset highlight stacks or text-shadow embossing.
**Don't** use purple, cobalt or vermilion as a generic accent, link or state colour.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or set the pad letters as live HTML text.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows; shadows under molded objects stay soft and negative-spread.
**Don't** drift toward the neon-waveform DAW or the pastel sleepy-ASMR page.
